mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.25% signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 9.0% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for two months, or Rank IC remains negative over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and consumer credit (RSAFS) indicate a contraction in household spending and investment, depressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline for two months, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion, declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 signals manufacturing slowdown that reduces corporate output and earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95.0 during late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC for regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5% for three consecutive months, it triggers monetary tightening expectations that increase equity discount rates, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5% for three months, or Rank IC is negative over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls above 200,000 per month signals strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS exceeds 200,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 2-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In high-growth GDP regimes (GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized), a decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) signals demand slowdown that reduces corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS declines during high-growth GDP (GDPC1 > 3.0% annualized), or Rank IC for regime is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 and housing starts (HOUST) below 450.0 indicate a broad economic slowdown that reduces corporate investment and consumer confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline for two months, or interaction term Rank IC is below 0.03.
